VISION
To be a globally recognized center of excellence in research and education, advancing knowledge and innovation in pathology, microbiology, and parasitology to address contemporary and emerging challenges in health and disease.
MISSION
Education Excellence
: To provide rigorous, research-driven training for MPhil and PhD scholars, equipping them with advanced skills and knowledge in pathology, microbiology, and parasitology.
Research Leadership
: To conduct innovative and interdisciplinary research addressing critical health challenges, fostering scientific discoveries that impact human and animal health.
Global Impact
: To contribute to the global scientific community through high-quality publications, partnerships, and translational research for sustainable health solutions.
Community Engagement
: To empower local and global communities by advancing diagnostic, therapeutic, and preventive measures through evidence-based findings and capacity building.
